preconditions: No localized fault, erosion, intrusion or lens event is authorized
Ordered finite section stations and positive layer thicknesses
requiredEvidence: Section span and drafting tick spacing

decisionLogic.contactGeometry: Generate only positive layer thickness fields and reuse each bottom array exactly as the next top array.
decisionLogic.frameClosure: Preserve the generated deepest geological boundary and fill only the interval to the enclosing drafting tick with one explicitly Unmodelled polygon.

uncertainty: All range fractions are uncalibrated display priors and establish no local geological truth.
exclusions: Treating the Unmodelled band as lithology or basement
validationMethod: contract polygon partition and classification test
native DWG hatch-pattern and reopen validation
reopenCondition: Measured contact statistics, a localized event path, another covariance family, or promotion beyond Experimental output.
